answer.text: Yes. The technical specifications list the fuel type as unleaded gasoline with an ethanol content of up to E20, so E20 is within what the manual allows.

disclaimers.text: The manual states E20 as the upper ethanol limit; it does not say anything about blends with more ethanol than E20.
